name: Party Registration And Guarantee Acknowledgement V 01
definition: The message PartyManagementPaymentAcknowledgement is sent from a trade partner to any partner requested through a PartyManagementPaymentAcknowledgemenNotification message to acknowledge the notified factoring service agreement. Depending on legal contexts, the acknowledgement may be required in order for the financial service agreement to become effective.|The message references related messages and may include referenced data.|The message can carry digital signatures if required by context.

Header.name: Header
Header.definition: Set of characteristics that unambiguously identify the acknowlegement, common parameters, documents and identifications.

AcknowledgementCount.name: Acknowledgement Count
AcknowledgementCount.definition: Number of acknowledgement lists as control value.

ItemCount.name: Item Count
ItemCount.definition: Total number of individual items in all lists.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in all lists, irrespective of currencies or direction.
